verdict.rationale: Phoenix has no automation or workflow engine in the evidence. The closest analog is Prompt Management: prompts can be versioned, stored and deployed, and synced across environments via SDK. Changes can also be reviewed before rollout by testing prompt variants across datasets and comparing experiment results, and datasets are versioned. missing for 10: versioning of actual automations or workflows (beyond prompts), an explicit documented rollback or revert-to-prior-version capability, a review or approval workflow for changes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
